     .contactbutton {
	background-color: #5bb1e4;
	border: none;
	color: white;
	padding: 12px 28px;
	border-radius: 8px;
	text-align: center;
	text-decoration: none;
	text-transform: uppercase;
	display: inline-block;
	font-size: 14pt;
	font-family:"Verlag A","Verlag B",Helvetica,Arial,"Nimbus Sans L",sans-serif;
	margin: 4px 2px;
	transition-duration: 0.4s;
	cursor: pointer;
}
.contactbutton:link,.contactbutton:visited {
	color: white;
}
.bluecontactbutton {
	background-color: #5bb1e4; 
	color: white; 
	border: 2px solid #5bb1e4;
}
.bluecontactbutton:hover {
	background-color: white;
	color: black;
}
.promobox {
	background-color: #135242;
	color: white;
padding-left: 20px;
padding-right: 20px;
padding-top: 1px;
padding-bottom: 1px;
}
* {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}
.main {
	float:left;
	width:70%;
	padding:0px;
}
.right {
	float:left;
	width:27%;
	padding:5px;
}
.right-top {
	align:right;
}
.right-bottom {
	background-color:#f4f1ea;
	padding:0 15px;
	margin-top:7px;
	margin-bottom:20px;
}
td.show-icons div {
  display: inline
}
@media only screen and (max-width:900px) {
	/* For mobile phones: */
	.main, .right {
		width:100%;
	}
	.right-top {
		visibility: hidden;
		display: none;
	}
}

      'use strict';
      $(document).ready(function() {
        var $extendedDescription = $('.landing-page-container__extended-description');
        if ($extendedDescription.length > 0) {
          var descriptionHeight = $extendedDescription.height();
          // Height should match css "max-height" in _shows-extended-description.scss
          if (descriptionHeight > 250) {
            $extendedDescription.addClass('closed');
            $extendedDescription.append('<div class="btn-wrapper"><a href="#" class="btn btn-trigger">Read More</a></div>');
            var $btn = $extendedDescription.find('.btn-trigger');
            $extendedDescription.on('click', '.btn-trigger', function(event) {
              var $this = $(this);
              event.preventDefault();
              var $wrapper = $this.parents('.landing-page-container__extended-description');
              if ($wrapper.hasClass('closed')) {
                $wrapper.removeClass('closed');
                $btn.html('Close');
              }
              else {
                $wrapper.addClass('closed');
                $btn.html('Read More');
              }
            });
          }
        }

      });
    })(window);

      $(document).ready(function() {
        var $extendedDescription = $('.landing-page-container__extended-description');
        if ($extendedDescription.length > 0) {
          var descriptionHeight = $extendedDescription.height();
          // Height should match css "max-height" in _shows-extended-description.scss
          if (descriptionHeight > 250) {
            $extendedDescription.addClass('closed');
            $extendedDescription.append('<div class="btn-wrapper"><a href="#" class="btn btn-trigger">Read More</a></div>');
            var $btn = $extendedDescription.find('.btn-trigger');
            $extendedDescription.on('click', '.btn-trigger', function(event) {
              var $this = $(this);
              event.preventDefault();
              var $wrapper = $this.parents('.landing-page-container__extended-description');
              if ($wrapper.hasClass('closed')) {
                $wrapper.removeClass('closed');
                $btn.html('Close');
              }
              else {
                $wrapper.addClass('closed');
                $btn.html('Read More');
              }
            });
          }
        }

      });
